rulings.docket_item: Merge Jer.12.1-Jer.12.6 into one petition-and-reply row (P04-011 absorbing P04-012)?
rulings.grounds: Re-derived from the pointed bytes. The seam the merge would delete carries a ruled tier-1 class. Jer.12.1-Jer.12.4 addresses the deity by name, צַדִּ֤יק אַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֔ה (oshb:Jer.12.1, byte tier) and וְאַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ יְדַעְתָּ֔נִי (oshb:Jer.12.3, byte tier), while 12:5 turns the second person onto the prophet, כִּ֣י אֶת רַגְלִ֥ים רַ֨צְתָּה֙ וַיַּלְא֔וּךָ (oshb:Jer.12.5, byte tier), and 12:6 brings a participant set standing nowhere in 12:1-12:4, אַחֶ֣יךָ וּבֵית אָבִ֗יךָ (oshb:Jer.12.6, byte tier). An explicit addressee-and-participant shift is a licensed tier-1 internal seam, so the cut survives on the ground the challenge itself supplies, not on the ground the row argues. The remaining arms verify. No messenger formula stands between the seam and either neighbour: the consonantal formula object returns 152 verses book-wide at MT keys with its nearest members at MT 11:22 and MT 12:14 and none between (sweep: 152 verses). The first person at 12:1 resumes the voice already standing at הֽוֹדִיעַ֖נִי וָֽאֵדָ֑עָה (oshb:Jer.11.18, byte tier) and גִּלִּ֥יתִי אֶת רִיבִֽי (oshb:Jer.11.20, byte tier) across the reply of 11:21-11:23, so the new-first-person-voice warrant is byte-false as charged. The treachery catchword straddling the seam is a disclosure obligation under the cross-seam cohesion rule, which a disclosure cures; it is not a seam-deleter. COUNT OBJECT CORRECTED, controlling object and digit pair named: the docket's 12-verse figure is a bare consonantal substring that blends three bases, the treachery family, the garment noun at MT 36:24, MT 41:5 and MT 52:33, and a bet-prefixed noun at MT 49:3, so it may not be cited as the treachery family's count. The controlling objects are the attested forms: בֹּ֥גְדֵי (oshb:Jer.12.1, byte tier) returns 1 verse at byte and at accent-stripped tier, and בָּ֣גְדוּ (oshb:Jer.12.6, byte tier) returns 1 verse at byte tier and 2 at accent-stripped tier (MT 5:11 and MT 12:6). The parashah layer is tier-3 weak single-witness corroboration in the Prophets and its absence at the 12:4|12:5 join is barred as evidence in either direction.

consequence.spec: SPANS UNCHANGED: P04-011 remains Jer.12.1-Jer.12.4 and P04-012 remains Jer.12.5-Jer.12.6, both lament_confession under M3 Jer.11.1-Jer.17.27; no retirement; the corpus tiling is untouched at 1364/1364 verses over 276 decisions. The docket work order on P04-011 STANDS IN FULL and is not narrowed: replace the new-first-person-voice wording with the resumption shown at oshb:Jer.11.18 and oshb:Jer.11.20 across the reply of 11:21-11:23; ground the cut before verse 5 on the addressee-and-participant shift read off the pointed bytes, the deity named as addressee in 12:1-12:4 and the prophet with his brothers and his father's house in 12:5-12:6; disclose BOTH straddling device sets with swept object and verse count; delete every sentence resting on a paragraph mark being absent. ADDED BEYOND THE DOCKET, three items. (1) SEAM-PAIR, ONE EDIT: the treachery catchword straddles the seam P04-011 and P04-012 share, so its disclosure is one edit installed on BOTH rows' device_notes with a single agreed wording; the two rows may not carry different objects, tiers or digits for it. (2) COUNT OBJECT: neither row may cite the 12-verse consonantal-substring digit as a treachery count. Each disclosure names the two attested forms separately with its own tier and digit, the construct participle at oshb:Jer.12.1 (1 verse, byte and accent-stripped tiers, MT keys) and the finite verb at oshb:Jer.12.6 (1 verse byte tier, 2 verses accent-stripped, MT 5:11 and MT 12:6), or else names the swept object as a bare consonantal substring and states in the same sentence that it blends the garment noun and a bet-prefixed noun. (3) P04-012's boundary_rationale states its own addressee from the pointed bytes rather than from the absence of a formula, and its medium_low confidence stands. Cure test unchanged and binding: the warrant states each half's addressee from the pointed bytes; every device straddling either row's own seams is disclosed with object and count; and no evidentiary sentence rests on marker absence.

rulings.docket_item: Split P05-014 (Jer.15.10-Jer.15.21) at 15:19 into complaint and second divine reply?
rulings.grounds: The challenge is byte-confirmed and the row's stated hold-together ground is byte-false. MT 15:11 opens the reply on a bare אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה (oshb:Jer.15.11, byte tier), which is neither one of the three word-event shapes nor a koh-amar; MT 15:15 turns to the prophet's own mouth, אַתָּ֧ה יָדַ֣עְתָּ יְהוָ֗ה זָכְרֵ֤נִי וּפָקְדֵ֨נִי֙ (oshb:Jer.15.15, byte tier); the first-person complaint holds through 15:16-15:18; and לָכֵ֞ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה (oshb:Jer.15.19, byte tier) therefore does change the speaking mouth. So 15:19 IS a licensed tier-1 seam and the row's reason for declining it is contradicted by the bytes it cites. Licensed is not compelled. The span is one exchange with one participant set: the adversaries answered at 15:20 are the people already standing at כֻּלֹּ֥ה מְקַלְלַֽונִי (oshb:Jer.15.10, byte tier) and מֵרֹ֣דְפַ֔י (oshb:Jer.15.15, byte tier), and 15:19-15:21 introduces no participant, addressee pair or scene that 15:10-15:18 does not already carry. That is what separates this seam from the two seams the corpus does cut in the same frame, where a named opponent set enters at MT 11:21 and the prophet's own brothers and father's house enter at MT 12:6. Cutting here would separate a reply from the complaint it answers on a seam that adds no participant, which is the over-split direction, and the confessions' speaker-frame edges are a held-open low-confidence region where honest reduced confidence, not a respan, is the disposition. Disclosure re-verified against the inventory: exactly two variant notes fall inside Jer.15.10-Jer.15.21, at MT 15:11, visible in the bytes as שרותך שֵֽׁרִיתִ֖יךָ (oshb:Jer.15.11, byte tier), and at MT 15:16, דבריך דְבָֽרְךָ֙ (oshb:Jer.15.16, byte tier); neither is disclosed. The parashah disclosure is complete and correctly typed, setumah at MT 15:10, 15:14, 15:16, 15:17 and 15:18 with a petuchah at MT 15:21, single-witness and tier-3 weak. COUNT OBJECT named for the outcry digit the row carries: the attested pointed form אֽוֹי (oshb:Jer.15.10, byte tier) returns 3 verses at byte and accent-stripped tiers (MT 4:31, 15:10, 45:3), and the bare consonantal substring returns 14 verses, blended with the enemy and fool bases and with the royal name at MT 52:31, so the row's 8-verse figure is a lexeme-level object distinct from both staged digits and true only under the object the row names, which it does name. Carried as a disclosure requirement, not as a defect finding.

consequence.spec: SPAN UNCHANGED: P05-014 remains Jer.15.10-Jer.15.21, lament_confession, parent M3 Jer.11.1-Jer.17.27; no new row, no retirement; tiling untouched at 1364/1364 verses over 276 decisions. The docket work order STANDS: rewrite strongest_rejected_alternative and the matching boundary_rationale clause on a true premise, that the divine reply does not run unbroken from 15:11 but breaks at 15:15 where the prophet's voice resumes, and that the formula at 15:19 opens a second divine reply with a changed speaking mouth; and add the single-witness ketiv/qere disclosure for MT 15:11 and MT 15:16. ADDED BEYOND THE DOCKET, three items. (1) THE REPLACEMENT HOLD-TOGETHER WARRANT IS NAMED and must pass the test that killed the original: it is the participant-set continuity across 15:19 read off the pointed bytes, the same adversaries standing on both sides, and the same field must concede that 15:19 is a licensed seam this unit declines to cut rather than a non-event. (2) confidence drops from medium to medium_low and frontier_flag_considered stays set: the unit is held whole against a licensed internal seam. (3) The outcry digit keeps naming its lexeme object explicitly and may not be re-labelled as a byte-tier or consonantal digit for the spliced form. Cure test unchanged and binding: a per-verse mouth check across Jer.15.10-Jer.15.21 must sustain every voice statement the prose makes, and every in-span variant verse must be named.

rulings.docket_item: Merge P06-004 (Jer.16.16-Jer.16.18) into the preceding row P06-003 (Jer.16.14-Jer.16.15)?
rulings.grounds: The continuity arm is byte-confirmed. MT 16:15 closes on third-person plural referents in the divine mouth, הִדִּיחָ֖ם שָׁ֑מָּה (oshb:Jer.16.15, byte tier); MT 16:16 keeps the same mouth and the same third-person plural referents, וְדִיג֑וּם (oshb:Jer.16.16, byte tier), through עֲוֺנָם֙ וְחַטָּאתָ֔ם (oshb:Jer.16.18, byte tier); and neither side of the seam carries an addressee at all. The declared narrative_frame.scene_shift is therefore not byte-carried, and the row may not stand at high confidence. The merge is nevertheless not compelled, on two byte facts the challenge does not reach. First, the seam verse is not bound backward: MT 16:16 opens on a first-person presentative plus participle, הִנְנִ֨י שֹׁלֵ֜חַ (oshb:Jer.16.16, byte tier), with no back-linking particle, and its construction differs from the announcement at לָכֵ֛ן הִנֵּֽה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים (oshb:Jer.16.14, byte tier) that opens the preceding unit. That is the opposite of the shape which does defeat a cut, where the seam verse itself opens on a back-linking particle and continues the direct address of the verse before it. Second, what straddles this seam is referential continuity only, and the cross-seam cohesion rule makes a straddling device an owed disclosure that disclosure cures, not a seam-deleter. Disclosure re-verified against the inventory: exactly one variant note falls in MT 16:16-16:18, at MT 16:16, visible in the bytes as לדוגים לְדַיָּגִ֥ים (oshb:Jer.16.16, byte tier), disclosed and correctly located; the parashah layer is complete and correctly typed, setumah at MT 16:15 and at MT 16:18, single-witness, tier-3 weak, never a driver, with absence never counterevidence. SWEEP-SCOPED AND NOT DECIDED HERE: whether a presentative announcement onset can carry a row seam where mouth and referents are unchanged is a corpus-wide question about the ruled seam classes; it is not folded into this row's fix and must be carried as its own corpus-wide order.

consequence.spec: SPANS UNCHANGED: P06-004 remains Jer.16.16-Jer.16.18, judgment_oracle, parent M3 Jer.11.1-Jer.17.27, and P06-003 remains Jer.16.14-Jer.16.15, salvation_oracle; no retirement; tiling untouched at 1364/1364 verses over 276 decisions. The docket work order STANDS: strike narrative_frame.scene_shift from observed_substrate_signals; rewrite strongest_rejected_alternative to test the BACKWARD join with 16:14-16:15 rather than the forward pairing with 16:19-16:21; disclose the third-person-plural continuity across the row's own opening seam against the row; cite the tier-3 mark at MT 16:15 as corroboration only, never as a driver. ADDED BEYOND THE DOCKET, four items. (1) The replacement signal must name a form the row's own bytes carry at 16:16, the presentative-plus-participle announcement onset, keyed under the speech_formula family of the dotted taxonomy, and the prose may NOT assert it as a licensed tier-1 driver: the seam is held explicitly as a low-warrant seam whose declared driver failed. (2) Because this is a driver swap, its dependent fields re-open in the SAME edit: observed_substrate_signals, strongest_rejected_alternative, unit_type and confidence. unit_type judgment_oracle is re-checked on the row's own bytes, the pursuit and the double recompense, and is retained. (3) confidence drops from high to medium_low and frontier_flag_considered is set. (4) No sentence may rest on a mark or a note being absent, and every mark citation stays single-witness-labelled with petuchah never conflated with setumah. Cure test binding: the seam must survive a cross-seam cohesion check with the straddling third-person continuity disclosed; the rejected rival must be the backward join the bytes make hardest to reject; and no field may claim a ruled seam class the bytes do not carry at 16:16.

rulings.docket_item: Respan folding Jer.17.12-Jer.17.13 into the Jer.17.14-Jer.17.18 petition?
rulings.grounds: Re-derived. The recurrence is real: the closing splice of P06-008 ends on יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ (oshb:Jer.17.13, byte tier) and MT 17:18 opens יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ רֹדְפַי֙ (oshb:Jer.17.18, byte tier), one string once cantillation is set aside. COUNT OBJECT CORRECTED, controlling object and digit pair named: the docket's 5-verse figure is the bare consonantal substring and it BLENDS two lexemes, the shaming lexeme at MT 8:12, MT 17:13 and MT 17:18 with the drying lexeme at MT 23:10, יָבְשׁ֖וּ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר (oshb:Jer.23.10, byte tier), and MT 50:38, וְיָבֵ֑שׁוּ (oshb:Jer.50.38, byte tier). The controlling object is the attested pointed form at accent-stripped tier, which returns exactly 3 verses at MT keys, 8:12, 17:13 and 17:18, all three the shaming lexeme and two of them in chapter 17; at byte tier the form is unique to MT 17:13 (sweep: 1 verse). Numbering is identity for every member, the crosswalk mapping MT 8:12 to WEB 8:12, and the book's single offset zone is confined to MT 8:23 and MT chapter 9, which no member touches. Under the cross-seam cohesion rule a byte-true device straddling the row's own seam argues continuity UNLESS DISCLOSED, which makes this an owed disclosure and a rival-weighing duty, not a respan ground. The seam itself is not shown wrong: the deity is addressed on BOTH sides, כָּל עֹזְבֶ֖יךָ (oshb:Jer.17.13, byte tier) and רְפָאֵ֤נִי יְהוָה֙ (oshb:Jer.17.14, byte tier), so no addressee change is available to either side of this question, and what turns is the speaker's own focus and grammatical number, first-person plural at מִקְדָּשֵֽׁנוּ (oshb:Jer.17.12, byte tier) to first-person singular at 17:14. Folding a sanctuary doxology into an individual petition on a device bond alone, at a confession speaker-frame edge that is a held-open low-confidence region, is not warranted; what fails is the disclosure and the rival weighing, exactly as graded.

consequence.spec: SPANS UNCHANGED: P06-008 remains Jer.17.12-Jer.17.13, hymn_doxology, and P06-009 remains Jer.17.14-Jer.17.18, lament_confession, both under M3 Jer.11.1-Jer.17.27; no retirement; tiling untouched at 1364/1364 verses over 276 decisions. The docket work order on P06-008 STANDS: device_notes gains one sentence disclosing the cross-seam recurrence at that row's own closing seam, and strongest_rejected_alternative replaces the backward-only rival with the FORWARD join to the 17:14-17:18 petition and states why the unit still stands, the field kept to one sentence plus at most the mandated rival-disclosure sentence. ADDED BEYOND THE DOCKET, two items. (1) SEAM-PAIR, ONE EDIT: the recurrence straddles the seam P06-008 and P06-009 share, so the disclosure is one edit installed on BOTH rows' device_notes with a single agreed wording; the companion work order for P06-009 is written at B2-7 and the two must not diverge in object, tier or digit. (2) THE DIGIT IS FIXED to the controlling object: the attested pointed form at accent-stripped tier, 3 verses at MT keys, two of them in chapter 17, with the byte tier named as differing by cantillation. The 5-verse consonantal figure may NOT be carried as the shaming lexeme's count; if a consonantal digit is cited at all, the same sentence must say it blends the drying lexeme at MT 23:10 and MT 50:38. Cure tests binding on both rows: the recurrence claim carries a tier label and an adjacent digit-bearing sweep naming the swept object and its unit, with no untiered identity wording; P06-008's rejected-alternative engages the FORWARD join; and every mark and variant disclosure already in each row stays correctly typed and single-witness-labelled.

rulings.docket_item: Fold Jer.18.13-Jer.18.17 back into the potter unit as the divine reply to the refusal at 18:12?
rulings.grounds: All five arms re-derived from the bytes and each holds; the seam is shown wrong, not merely mislabelled. (i) The mouth does not change across it: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה already stands inside oshb:Jer.18.11 (byte tier), within the command to speak to Judah, and the formula at 18:13 is subordinated to the verse-initial back-linking particle לָכֵ֗ן (oshb:Jer.18.13, byte tier), so a koh-amar onset WITH a frame-owner change, the only arm under which that formula licenses a cut, is not present. (ii) Direct address continues across the seam: the second-person-plural addressees of עֲלֵיכֶם֙ and שׁ֣וּבוּ נָ֗א (both oshb:Jer.18.11, byte tier) are the hearers commanded at שַֽׁאֲלוּ נָא֙ (oshb:Jer.18.13, byte tier), and the third-person material the row names begins only mid-verse at בְּתוּלַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל (oshb:Jer.18.13, byte tier), so the stated turn from direct second-person address to third-person description is byte-contradicted at the row's own onset verse. (iii) The unclaimed discourse-imperative candidate fails against the class as the ruled exemplars carry it: both are verse-initial and un-subordinated and each summons its hearers to OPEN a discourse, הַגִּ֣ידוּ בִֽיהוּדָ֗ה (oshb:Jer.4.5, byte tier) and שִׁמְע֣וּ אֶת הַדָּבָ֗ר (oshb:Jer.10.1, byte tier), whereas 18:13's imperative is neither verse-initial nor un-subordinated, stands inside quoted divine speech introduced by the messenger formula, and the identical shape two verses earlier at 18:11 opens nothing. (iv) The poetry-line contrast is tier-4 translation layout, barred as boundary evidence in either direction, and the staged original-language material carries no verse-structure layer. (v) The devising root brackets the span on BOTH seams, each object swept separately at MT keys and never blended: the singular noun מַֽחֲשָׁבָ֑ה (oshb:Jer.18.11, byte tier), 1 verse at byte tier and 2 verses at the consonantal substring (MT 18:11 and MT 49:30); the suffixed plural מַחְשְׁבוֹתֵ֨ינוּ֙ (oshb:Jer.18.12, byte tier), 1 verse at every tier; the cohortative וְנַחְשְׁבָ֣ה (oshb:Jer.18.18, byte tier), 1 verse at every tier; and the plural noun מַחֲשָׁבוֹת֒ (oshb:Jer.18.18, byte tier), 1 verse byte tier, 2 verses accent-stripped and 9 verses at the consonantal substring, of which only MT 18:12 and MT 18:18 fall in chapters 17-19. With no member of the ruled seam classes at the 18:12|18:17 opening seam, with divine mouth and direct address continuing across it, and with the row's own rejected-alternative conceding that the therefore of 18:13 answers the refusal quoted at 18:12, the cut is unlicensed and the material belongs to the unit it answers. The one variant note inside 18:13-18:17 stands at MT 18:16, visible in the bytes as שרוקת שְׁרִיק֣וֹת (oshb:Jer.18.16, byte tier), and is disclosed nowhere.

consequence.spec: ADOPTED RESPAN. P06-011 respans from Jer.18.1-Jer.18.12 to Jer.18.1-Jer.18.17; unit_type symbolic_act_report; parent_collection M4 Jer.18.1-Jer.20.18. P06-012 (Jer.18.13-Jer.18.17, judgment_oracle) RETIRES. P06-013 (Jer.18.18-Jer.18.23, lament_confession, M4) keeps its span. TILING: Jer.18.1-Jer.18.17 plus Jer.18.18-Jer.18.23 covers Jer.18.1-Jer.18.23 with no gap and no overlap; the book stays at 1364/1364 verses, decisions falling from 276 to 275. NO FRAME SEAM IS CROSSED: the merged row lies wholly inside M4 Jer.18.1-Jer.20.18 and does not touch the 17:27|18:1 frame seam. The whole-chapter cap is not engaged: chapter 18 carries 23 verses and the merged span is 17. EDITS ON THE RESPANNED P06-011, ALL IN ONE EDIT. (a) boundary_rationale extends to the appended material and carries the corrected person fact, that second-person-plural address continues into 18:13 through its imperative and the third-person description begins mid-verse at the virgin-of-Israel clause, and states that the unit is held whole because no member of the ruled seam classes falls at the 18:12|18:13 join. No tier-4 layout fact may appear anywhere as a boundary ground or as counterevidence. (b) strongest_rejected_alternative is re-cut to the rival now rejected, holding 18:13-18:17 as a separate indictment on its own messenger formula, and states why that formula does not license it: same mouth as 18:11, subordinated to a back-linking particle. (c) observed_substrate_signals: the existing word_event and symbolic_act command, performance and interpretation keys stand; no key may assert a frame-owner change at 18:13. (d) unit_type stays symbolic_act_report, with a ONE-SENTENCE operative-category deviation disclosure in device_notes for the indictment material now inside the span. (e) confidence is set to medium_low and frontier_flag_considered is set. (f) device_notes carries the FULL span-relevant disclosure sweep for Jer.18.1-Jer.18.17, which the merge enlarges: variant notes at MT 18:3, MT 18:10 and MT 18:16, of which MT 18:10 and MT 18:16 are disclosed in NEITHER source row today and are owed; and parashah marks petuchah at MT 18:4 and setumah at MT 18:6, MT 18:8, MT 18:10 and MT 18:12, with the row's own close setumah at MT 18:17 and the front-seam petuchah at MT 17:27 - every citation single-witness labelled, petuchah never conflated with setumah, absence never counterevidence. (g) SEAM-PAIR, ONE EDIT: the devising-root bracket now straddles only this row's CLOSING seam at 18:17|18:18, so its disclosure is one edit installed on both the respanned P06-011 and P06-013, naming each attested form separately with its own tier and digit as swept in the grounds; no blended sweep. EDIT ON P06-013: the boundary_rationale phrase describing the preceding unit as a third-person judgment oracle is re-cut to the merged unit, verse-anchored, with no positional or cross-row register. SUPERSEDED AND ABSORBED: items (1) and (2) of the P06-012 work order are SUPERSEDED by the retirement; item (3)'s two disclosures, the MT 18:16 variant note and the devising-root bracket, are ABSORBED into the respanned P06-011 at (f) and (g). The P06-012 cure tests carry over unchanged to this edit: no tier-4 layout fact anywhere as a boundary ground or counterevidence; every named driver byte-present and carrying the change the ruled granularity requires; cross-seam device disclosure naming each swept form separately with its unit and digit; and variant-note disclosure symmetric with parashah disclosure. SWEEP-SCOPED, NOT FOLDED IN: the chunk_index_in_book resequencing that follows the retirement is a corpus-scoped mechanical order carried as its own sweep; and this ruling is decision-local - it does not license a corpus-wide re-cut of other seams sharing this shape.

rulings.grounds: The challenge's core is byte-confirmed. At MT 22:1 the house is the destination of the commission with no preposition, רֵ֖ד בֵּֽית מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה (oshb:Jer.22.1, byte tier), and 22:2 addresses the king in the singular, שְׁמַ֣ע דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה and אַתָּ֤ה וַעֲבָדֶ֨יךָ֙ (both oshb:Jer.22.2, byte tier); at MT 22:6 the same three-word phrase returns under the preposition, עַל בֵּית֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה (oshb:Jer.22.6, byte tier), and the address is to the house itself, גִּלְעָ֥ד אַתָּ֛ה לִ֖י (oshb:Jer.22.6, byte tier), continued at מִבְחַ֣ר אֲרָזֶ֔יךָ (oshb:Jer.22.7, byte tier). The phrase is a 7-verse object at consonantal tier (sweep: 7 verses at MT keys, 21:11, 22:1, 22:6, 27:18, 27:21, 32:2 and 38:22), and this span carries two of its members under two frames. So the addressee does change and the rejected alternative's stated ground is byte-false. The cut is nevertheless DECLINED: the referent addressed at 22:6 is the one already named at the row's own onset as the errand's destination, and everything from 22:2 to 22:9 stands inside the single commissioned utterance that 22:1 orders spoken there, וְדִבַּרְתָּ֣ שָׁ֔ם אֶת הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּֽה (oshb:Jer.22.1, byte tier), one word in the singular on one errand, while the formula at 22:6 is itself subordinated to the causal particle כִּֽי (oshb:Jer.22.6, byte tier) and brings no frame-owner change. A re-address of the destination already named at the onset, inside one commissioned word, does not open a fresh unit. The setumah recorded at MT 22:5 falls exactly at the declined juncture and is tier-3 weak single-witness corroboration in the Prophets, never a driver, with absence never counterevidence. Disclosure re-verified against the inventory: exactly two variant notes fall inside Jer.22.1-Jer.22.9, one at MT 22:4, visible in the bytes as עָשׂוֹ֙ תַּֽעֲשׂ֔וּ (oshb:Jer.22.4, byte tier), and one verse-final at MT 22:6, נושבה נוֹשָֽׁבוּ (oshb:Jer.22.6, byte tier); neither is disclosed. The parashah disclosure is complete and correctly typed, setumah at MT 22:2, MT 22:5 and the row's own close at MT 22:9.
